# 08 — The camera

*Written by the suite from [`tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd`](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

The orbit camera of ADR-001, and the thing it is most likely to break.

Two halves, and the second is the one worth the suite. The first is geometry:
the orbit is an *offset* on the hole's framing, so a centred orbit has to hand
back exactly the transform it was given, and no amount of dragging may put the
camera under the deck, on the pole, or somewhere the pin cannot be found.

The second is the collision. `StrokeGesture` starts a stroke on a press
anywhere on the screen -- deliberately, it is Pillar 3 -- and the orbit takes
two fingers on the same screen. The failure that costs a player a shot is a
second finger landing mid-drag and the stroke going off as they let go. So the
last tests here are about which gesture wins, and they drive the two objects
wired together exactly as the range wires them.

## What the suite asserts

- [A centred orbit hands the framing straight back](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L70)
- [Yaw walks around the focus without leaving it](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L81)
- [It never drops under the deck](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L98)
- [It never reaches the pole](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L112)
- [Zoom stops at both ends](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L126)
- [A close framing zoomed in still leaves room](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L139)
- [Recentring restores the framing exactly](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L147)
- [One finger leaves the camera alone](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L163)
- [Two fingers turn the camera](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L174)
- [Pinching apart comes closer](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L185)
- [A second finger drops the stroke instead of playing it](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L197)
- [Taking hold of the camera does not also recentre it](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L218)
- [A tap puts the camera back on the line of play](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L239)
- [A stroke that was taken back is not a tap](../tests/camera/test_camera_orbit.gd#L253)
